_comment: Maps code areas to manual pages. It is the contract between the two halves
of the repository and belongs to neither, so it sits at the root.
`code` entries are regexes matched against changed file paths as GitLab
reports them, repo-root-relative. `pages` are filenames inside
<docRoot>/<language>/, so one entry covers all three languages.
Console routes do not need entries here: _<route>.md is derived from the
route table by scripts/check-missing-doc.js. This file covers what that
no-doc-impact entries matter as much as the others. They record why the

areas._comment: Not pages. search.md is injected into combined.html, break.md into the PDF.

_comment: The manual is DocBot's destination, never its trigger. Without this
entry a bot-authored merge request would trigger the next run.
docbot also skips merge requests labelled docbot-generated; this entry
covers what that label cannot, a human editing the manual by hand.
